summary: A nonzero amplitude sum would force the characters to agree.

steps.claim: Suppose A_T(c, s, c') ≠ 0. For u, u' ∈ K ∩ 𝖴 with reduction(u)·s = s·reduction(u'), amplitudeSum_besselU_mul gives A_T(c, s, c') = A_T(c, reduction(u)·s·reduction(u')⁻¹, c') = (unipotentChar(u)⁻¹unipotentChar(u'))·A_T(c, s, c'), so unipotentChar(u)⁻¹unipotentChar(u') = 1 (scalar multiplication of a nonzero vector is injective): s would agree, contradicting hs.
